chunks: And with his chain of narration, he said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:
No one who is in a state of major ritual impurity (junub) is permitted [to pray] in this mosque except me, Ali, Fatima, Al-Hasan, Al-Husayn, and whoever is from my Household, for they are from me.

key_terms.يُجْنِبُ: One who is in a state of major ritual impurity (junub)

ai.seo_question: Who is exempt from the prohibition of praying in the mosque while in a state of major ritual impurity (junub)?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the unique ritual privilege of the Ahl al-Bayt to remain in the mosque while in a state of major impurity (junub), distinguishing them from the general Ummah. It underscores their intrinsic spiritual purity and closeness to the Prophet, reinforcing the Shia doctrine of their exceptional status as extensions of the Prophet's own self. This exception serves as a practical manifestation of their divine selection and purity (Ismah) in daily worship practices.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-236 According to the same documentation,the Prophet (S) said, “

No one is allowed to go through this mosque except for me, Ali (a.s.), (the Blessed Lady) Fatima (a.s.), Al-Hassan (a.s.), Al-Husayn (a.s.) and whoever is a member of my Household since they are from me.”
